chapters.title: How Master Cherry the carpenter found a piece of wood that cried and laughed like a child.
Master Cherry gives the piece of wood to his friend Geppetto, who takes it to make himself a wonderful puppet that can dance, fence with a sword, and turn somersaults.
Back home, Geppetto starts making the puppet at once and names him Pinocchio. The puppet’s first naughty tricks.
The story of Pinocchio and the Talking Cricket, which shows how naughty children hate being corrected by those who know more than they do.
Pinocchio is hungry and finds an egg to make an omelette; but just at the best moment, the omelette flies out of the window.
Pinocchio falls asleep with his feet on the pot of coals, and next morning wakes up with his feet burned away.
Geppetto comes home and gives the puppet the breakfast the poor man had brought for himself.
Geppetto makes Pinocchio new feet and sells his own coat to buy him an ABC book.
Pinocchio sells his ABC book to go and see the puppet theatre.
The puppets recognise their brother Pinocchio and give him a wonderful welcome; but just at the best moment the puppet master Fire-Eater appears, and Pinocchio is in danger of a terrible end.
Fire-Eater sneezes and forgives Pinocchio, who then saves his friend Harlequin from death.
The puppet master Fire-Eater gives Pinocchio five gold coins to take to his dad Geppetto; but instead Pinocchio lets the Fox and the Cat trick him and goes off with them.
The Red Crayfish Inn.
Having ignored the Talking Cricket’s good advice, Pinocchio runs into the murderers.
The murderers chase Pinocchio; and after catching him, they hang him from a branch of the Great Oak.
The beautiful blue-haired Girl has the puppet brought in: she puts him to bed and calls three doctors to find out whether he is alive or dead.
Pinocchio eats the sugar but will not take his medicine; when he sees the gravediggers coming to take him away, he takes it. Then he tells a lie, and his nose grows as punishment.
Pinocchio meets the Fox and the Cat again and goes with them to plant the four coins in the Field of Miracles.
Pinocchio is robbed of his gold coins, and as punishment gets four months in prison.
Freed from prison, he sets off for the Fairy’s house; but along the way he meets a horrible snake, and then gets caught in a trap.
Pinocchio is caught by a farmer, who forces him to act as watchdog for a henhouse.
Pinocchio discovers the thieves and is set free as a reward for being faithful.
Pinocchio mourns the death of the lovely Girl with the blue hair: then he meets a Pigeon who carries him to the seashore, where he jumps into the water to help his father Geppetto.
Pinocchio reaches the island of the Busy Bees and finds the Fairy again.
Pinocchio promises the Fairy to be good and to study, because he is tired of being a puppet and wants to become a good boy.
Pinocchio goes to the seashore with his schoolmates to see the terrible Shark.
A great fight breaks out between Pinocchio and his schoolmates: one of them is hurt, and Pinocchio is arrested by the police.
Pinocchio is in danger of being fried in a pan like a fish.
He returns to the Fairy’s house, and she promises that the next day he will no longer be a puppet but will become a boy. A grand breakfast of milky coffee is planned to celebrate this great event.
Instead of becoming a boy, Pinocchio secretly leaves with his friend Candlewick for the Land of Toys.
After five months of easy living, Pinocchio is amazed to find a fine pair of donkey ears growing, and becomes a little donkey, tail and all.
Pinocchio grows donkey ears, then becomes a real little donkey and starts to bray.

Now a real little donkey, he is taken to be sold, and the Director of a company of clowns buys him to teach him to dance and jump through hoops: but one evening he becomes lame, and another man buys him to make a drum from his skin.
Thrown into the sea, Pinocchio is eaten by fish and becomes a puppet again: but as he swims to safety, he is swallowed by the terrible Shark.
Inside the Shark, Pinocchio finds… who does he find? Read this chapter and you will know.
At last Pinocchio stops being a puppet and becomes a boy.
